この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式 F^=h^+∑j∈occ(2J^j−K^j),F^ϕi=εiϕi FC=SCε,C†SC=I 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、一般に非局所な交換を含みます。公開例は、球対称1s² Heの局所還元と、別の分子積分実装による固定入力のH₂ RHFです。原子例と分子例では基底・離散化・参照が異なります。各例の範囲は下の固定入力・検証記録で確認してください。一般多中心分子・開殻・相関を含む解法の検証ではありません。 電子の定常Schrödinger方程式 H^elΨ=EelΨ,Etot=Eel+∑A<BZAZBRAB 固定核・非相対論の電子多体固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。実行例は1電子の孤立水素型原子に限定。一般の多電子直接解法は未実装。 実行例で使う式 共通実行例近似・離散化の式 H₂分子RHF：独立参照・SCF・s型基底拡大 F(P)C=SCε,P=2CoCoT ERHF=12Tr⁡[P(h+F)]+1/R 孤立2電子RHF・有限s型Gaussian基底。数値収束とRHF近似の誤差は別。 厳密解・参照解 小さな固定H₂モデルの独立RHF参照とSCF・s型基底の検査を使います。有限基底RHFの一致は完全な電子相関を含む厳密分子解の一致ではありません。 実行例の参照と結果 共通実行例 H₂分子RHF：独立参照・SCF・s型基底拡大 text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM H₂ molecular RHF: independent reference, SCF and s-basis refinement Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Fixed-input H₂ RHF: separate geometry, s-basis sequence and SCF-tolerance comparisons. Reading states PySCF differences, histories and remaining finite-basis limits. Equations and problem definitions Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters. Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations F^=h^+∑j∈occ(2J^j−K^j),F^ϕi=εiϕi FC=SCε,C†SC=I Closed-shell RHF equations for occupied spatial orbitals generally include nonlocal exchange. Published examples cover the spherical 1s²-helium local reduction and fixed-input H₂ RHF using a separate molecular-integral implementation. Their bases, discretizations and references differ; inspect each input and validation record below. These examples do not validate general multicenter molecules, open shells or correlated methods. Stationary electronic Schrödinger equation H^elΨ=EelΨ,Etot=Eel+∑A<BZAZBRAB Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic many-body eigenproblem; add nuclear repulsion separately. Runnable examples cover only isolated one-electron hydrogenic atoms, not direct general many-electron solutions. Formulations used by execution examples Common execution exampleApproximation or discretization H₂ molecular RHF: independent reference, SCF and s-basis refinement F(P)C=SCε,P=2CoCoT ERHF=12Tr⁡[P(h+F)]+1/R Isolated two-electron RHF in finite s-Gaussian bases. Numerical convergence differs from RHF model error. Exact and reference solutions Use independent RHF references and SCF/s-type-basis checks for a small fixed H₂ model. Agreement in finite-basis RHF is not agreement with a fully correlated exact molecular solution. References and results of execution examples Common execution example H₂ molecular RHF: independent reference, SCF and s-basis refinement Independent PySCF imports no educational solver. Same-geometry, same-finite-basis RHF, not an exact correlated solution. Independent PySCF imports no educational solver. Same-geometry, same-finite-basis RHF, not an exact correlated solution. Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Fixed nuclei, singlet restricted HF, one doubly occupied spatial orbital. Original Gaussian integrals and independent PySCF use identical geometries and bases. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP.
